summary: The diff implements Rename functionality in the My Files section by adding RenameFileDialog component and modifying FileList.tsx to include Rename in both the bulk action bar and three-dot context menu. Most requirements appear implemented, but there are concerns about the file rename actually working (backend stub shows error toast) and some AC details need verification from truncated code.

missing_requirements.requirement: After confirming the rename, the file or folder name updates in the list and a success toast is shown (REQ-2 AC)
missing_requirements.reason: The RenameFileDialog.tsx explicitly shows a toast.error('Rename file is not yet supported by the backend.') instead of performing the rename and showing a success toast. The file rename dialog is a non-functional stub that never calls onRenamed or shows a success toast.

hallucinated_features.description: useRenameFolder hook is imported in RenameFileDialog.tsx but never used — the component is for renaming files yet imports a folder rename hook without invoking it
hallucinated_features.reason: The import of useRenameFolder in RenameFileDialog is unused dead code not requested by any requirement
